title: Sturdy V2 (Ethereum) — per-strategy oracle / collateral-accounting residual
closed_reasons: no V2 oracle reads a spot DEX price: zero getReserves()/slot0() selectors in all 23 oracle bytecodes
the only LP-derived leg is Curve get_virtual_price() (D/totalSupply, swap-invariant); crvUSD leg uses the LLAMMA price_oracle() EMA
Chainlink/RedStone legs are freshness-checked (MAX_ORACLE_DELAY = 86400 s); Pendle PT legs use a 1800 s TWAP; ERC-4626 legs use convertToShares / Yearn pricePerShare
maxOracleDeviation = 0 on all 23 pairs AND every live oracle returns priceLow == priceHigh, so the V2 deviation guard is satisfied trivially (vacuous)

no free-mint collateral: ERC-4626 deposits mint at the same mark the oracle reads
